## Calculate VoA (reference: d.center)

```{r}
d.center.long <- d.center %>% pivot_longer(starts_with("item_"), names_to = "item_id", values_to = "prob") %>% 
  mutate(item_num = parse_number(item_id))
```


```{r}
# Example

target_item <- 14

dat <- d.center.long %>% filter(item_num == target_item) %>% 
  left_join(d.item, by="item_id")

fit <- nls(prob ~ 1 / (1 + exp(-(b + a * pTot))),  # logistic nls fit
  # data = dat,
  data = dat %>% bind_rows(tibble(pTot = rep(0, 30), prob = rep(0, 30))),
  # add dummy data (0, 0) * 30 times to consider the assumption ("total vocab = 0" means "each word's prob = 0") 
  algorithm = "port",
  start = list(b = -5, a = 10),
  control = nls.control(maxiter = 200))
# summary(fit)

pars <- coef(fit)
a <- pars["a"]
b <- pars["b"]

VoA <- -b / a          # pTot at prob = 0.5
slope_at_05 <- a / 4   # slope at prob = 0.5

newdat <- tibble(pTot = seq(0.0, 1.0, length.out = 200))
newdat$pred <- predict(fit, newdata = newdat)

ggplot(dat, aes(pTot, prob)) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.005, alpha = .3, size = 1) +
  geom_line(data = newdat, aes(y = pred), linewidth = 1.5, colour = "#2C7BB6") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = VoA, linetype = "dashed", colour = "red", linewidth = 0.7) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0.5, linetype = "dotted", color="gray20", linewidth = 0.7) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits=c(0,1), breaks = seq(0,1,0.2)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits=c(0,1), breaks = seq(0,1,0.25)) +
  labs(
    title = paste0("item_", target_item, ": ", first(dat$item_definition), "(", first(dat$english_gloss), ")"),
    subtitle = paste0("VoA = ", round(VoA,3), ", AoA = ", first(dat$AoA)),
    x = "Total vocabulary size (prop)",
    y = "Probability") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 13)

ggsave(here("Figures", "MA_VoA", paste0("MA_itemID_", sprintf("%03d", target_item), ".png")), width = 5, height = 4, dpi = 300)

d.out <- data.frame(
  item_num = target_item,
  VoA_raw = VoA,
  slope_at_05_raw = slope_at_05) %>% 
  mutate(VoA = case_when(VoA_raw < 0.05 ~ 0.05, VoA_raw > 0.95 ~ 0.95, TRUE ~ VoA_raw),
         VoA_status = case_when(VoA_raw < 0.05 ~ "early", VoA_raw > 0.95 ~ "late", TRUE ~ "observed"),
         slope_at_05 = if_else(VoA_status == "observed", slope_at_05_raw, NA_real_))
```

```{r}
item_list <- sort(unique(d.center.long$item_num))
d.out <- data.frame()

for (target_item in item_list) {
  
  dat <- d.center.long %>% filter(item_num == target_item) %>% 
    left_join(d.item, by="item_id")
  
  fit <- tryCatch(
    nls(prob ~ 1 / (1 + exp(-(b + a * pTot))),
        # data = dat
        data = dat %>% bind_rows(tibble(pTot = rep(0, 30), prob = rep(0, 30))),  
        # add dummy data (0, 0) * 30 times to consider the assumption ("total vocab = 0" means "each word's prob = 0") 
        algorithm = "port",
        start = list(b = -5, a = 10),
        control = nls.control(maxiter = 200)),
    error = function(e) NULL)
  
  if (is.null(fit)) {
    
    d.tmp <- data.frame(
      item_num = target_item,
      VoA_raw = NA_real_,
      slope_at_05_raw = NA_real_,
      VoA = NA_real_,
      VoA_status = "failed",
      slope_at_05 = NA_real_)
    
    d.out <- bind_rows(d.out, d.tmp)
    next
  }
  
  pars <- coef(fit)
  a <- pars["a"]
  b <- pars["b"]
  
  VoA <- -b / a
  slope_at_05 <- a / 4
  
  newdat <- tibble(pTot = seq(0.0, 1.0, length.out = 200))
  newdat$pred <- predict(fit, newdata = newdat)
  
  p <- ggplot(dat, aes(pTot, prob)) +
    geom_jitter(width = 0.005, alpha = .3, size = 1) +
    geom_line(data = newdat, aes(y = pred), linewidth = 1.5, colour = "#2C7BB6") +
    geom_vline(xintercept = VoA, linetype = "dashed", colour = "red", linewidth = 0.7) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0.5, linetype = "dotted", color = "gray20", linewidth = 0.7) +
    scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 1), breaks = seq(0, 1, 0.2)) +
    scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1), breaks = seq(0, 1, 0.25)) +
    labs(
      title = paste0("item_", target_item, ": ", first(dat$item_definition), "(", first(dat$english_gloss), ")"),
      subtitle = paste0("VoA = ", round(VoA, 3), ", AoA = ", first(dat$AoA)),
      x = "Total vocabulary size (prop)",
      y = "Probability") +
    theme_bw(base_size = 13)
  
  ggsave(here("Figures", "MA_VoA", paste0("MA_itemID_", sprintf("%03d", target_item), ".png")),
    plot = p, width = 5, height = 4, dpi = 300)
  
  d.tmp <- data.frame(
    item_num = target_item,
    VoA_raw = VoA,
    slope_at_05_raw = slope_at_05) %>%
    mutate(
      VoA = case_when(VoA_raw < 0.05 ~ 0.05, VoA_raw > 0.95 ~ 0.95, TRUE ~ VoA_raw),
      VoA_status = case_when(VoA_raw < 0.05 ~ "early", VoA_raw > 0.95 ~ "late", TRUE ~ "observed"),
      slope_at_05 = if_else(VoA_status == "observed", slope_at_05_raw, NA_real_))
  
  d.out <- bind_rows(d.out, d.tmp)
}

d.item <- d.item %>% mutate(item_num = parse_number(item_id)) %>% left_join(d.out, by="item_num") %>% 
  select(-item_num)
write.csv(d.item, here("Data_vaesampled_2025Dec19", "Mandarin_WS_Items_with_VoA.csv"))

d.item <- read_csv(here("Data_vaesampled_2025Dec19", "Mandarin_WS_Items_with_VoA.csv"), locale = locale(encoding = "UTF-8"))
```

## Left-Right axis

### By item

```{r}
d.left.long <- d.left %>% pivot_longer(starts_with("item_"), names_to = "item_id", values_to = "prob")
d.right.long <- d.right %>% pivot_longer(starts_with("item_"), names_to = "item_id", values_to = "prob")

left.summary <- d.left.long %>% group_by(pTot, item_id) %>%
  summarize(mean_1 = mean(prob), var_1 = var(prob), .groups = "drop")
right.summary <- d.right.long %>% group_by(pTot, item_id) %>%
  summarize(mean_2 = mean(prob), var_2 = var(prob), .groups = "drop")

diff.summary <- left.summary %>% left_join(right.summary, by=c("pTot", "item_id")) %>%
  mutate(mean_diff = mean_1 - mean_2, 
         sd_diff   = sqrt(var_1 + var_2)) %>%
  left_join(d.item, by = c("item_id"))
```

```{r}
# Visualization, example 1

target_pTot <- 0.5

plot.dat <- diff.summary %>%
  filter(pTot == target_pTot) %>%
  mutate(
    category1 = factor(category1, levels = cat1_levels),
    category2 = factor(category2, levels = cat2_levels),
    item_num = parse_number(item_id)) %>%
  # arrange(category1, item_num) %>%                    # if you want to arrange items by item_id
  arrange(category1, is.na(VoA_raw), VoA_raw, item_num) %>%   # if you want to arrange items by VoA
  mutate(
    x = row_number(),
    ymin = mean_diff - sd_diff,
    ymax = mean_diff + sd_diff)

cat.pos <- plot.dat %>%
  group_by(category1) %>%
  summarise(
    xmin = min(x),
    xmax = max(x),
    xmid = (xmin + xmax) / 2,
    .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(
    cat_label = cat1_labels[as.character(category1)],
    band_id = row_number())

vline.dat <- cat.pos %>% slice(-n())


ggplot(plot.dat, aes(x = x, y = mean_diff, color = category2)) +
  geom_rect(
    data = cat.pos,
    aes(
      xmin = xmin - 0.5,
      xmax = xmax + 0.5,
      ymin = -Inf,
      ymax = Inf,
      fill = factor(band_id %% 2)),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    alpha = 0.06,
    colour = NA,
    show.legend = FALSE) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("0" = "grey70", "1" = "white")) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, colour = "grey70", linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_linerange(
    aes(ymin = ymin, ymax = ymax),
    alpha = 0.22, linewidth = 0.35) +
  geom_segment(
    aes(xend = x, y = 0, yend = mean_diff),
    alpha = 0.25, linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_point(size = 1.1, alpha = 0.9) +
  geom_vline(
    data = vline.dat,
    aes(xintercept = xmax + 0.5),
    linetype = "dashed",
    colour = "grey75",
    linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_text(
    data = cat.pos,
    aes(x = xmid, y = 0.85, label = cat_label),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    vjust = 1,
    size = 2.6,
    lineheight = 0.9,
    colour = "grey10") +
  scale_color_manual(values = cols, drop = FALSE) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = plot.dat$x[seq(1, nrow(plot.dat), by = 20)],
    labels = plot.dat$item_id[seq(1, nrow(plot.dat), by = 20)],
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0.005, 0.005))) +
  scale_y_continuous(
      limits = c(-0.94, 0.94),
      breaks = seq(-1, 1, by = 0.2)) +
  labs(
    x = "Item",
    y = expression(Delta*"Production probability (Left - Right)"),
    title = paste0("Total vocabulary size (prop) = ", target_pTot),
    colour = NULL) +
  coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor.x = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 1, size = 7),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "top",
    plot.margin = margin(t = 10, r = 10, b = 10, l = 10))

ggsave(here("Figures", "MA_LR_by_itemID", paste0("MA_01_Diff_LR_pTot_", target_pTot, ".png")), width = 18, height = 6, dpi = 300)
# ggsave(here("Figures", "MA_LR_by_VoA", paste0("MA_01_Diff_LR_pTot_", target_pTot, ".png")), width = 18, height = 6, dpi = 300)
```

```{r}
plot_diff_by_item_pTot <- function(target_pTot, diff_df) {
  
  plot.dat <- diff.summary %>%
  filter(pTot == target_pTot) %>%
  mutate(
    category1 = factor(category1, levels = cat1_levels),
    category2 = factor(category2, levels = cat2_levels),
    item_num = parse_number(item_id)) %>%
  # arrange(category1, item_num) %>%                    # if you want to arrange items by item_id
  arrange(category1, is.na(VoA_raw), VoA_raw, item_num) %>%   # if you want to arrange items by VoA
  mutate(
    x = row_number(),
    ymin = mean_diff - sd_diff,
    ymax = mean_diff + sd_diff)
  
  cat.pos <- plot.dat %>%
    group_by(category1) %>%
    summarise(
      xmin = min(x),
      xmax = max(x),
      xmid = (xmin + xmax) / 2,
      .groups = "drop") %>%
    mutate(
      cat_label = cat1_labels[as.character(category1)],
      band_id = row_number())
  
  vline.dat <- cat.pos %>% slice(-n())

  ggplot(plot.dat, aes(x = x, y = mean_diff, color = category2)) +
    geom_rect(
      data = cat.pos,
      aes(
        xmin = xmin - 0.5,
        xmax = xmax + 0.5,
        ymin = -Inf,
        ymax = Inf,
        fill = factor(band_id %% 2)),
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      alpha = 0.06,
      colour = NA,
      show.legend = FALSE) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("0" = "grey70", "1" = "white")) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, colour = "grey70", linewidth = 0.4) +
    geom_linerange(
      aes(ymin = ymin, ymax = ymax),
      alpha = 0.22, linewidth = 0.35) +
    geom_segment(
      aes(xend = x, y = 0, yend = mean_diff),
      alpha = 0.25, linewidth = 0.3) +
    geom_point(size = 1.1, alpha = 0.9) +
    geom_vline(
      data = vline.dat,
      aes(xintercept = xmax + 0.5),
      linetype = "dashed",
      colour = "grey75",
      linewidth = 0.4) +
    geom_text(
      data = cat.pos,
      aes(x = xmid, y = 0.85, label = cat_label),
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      vjust = 1,
      size = 2.6,
      lineheight = 0.9,
      colour = "grey10") +
    scale_color_manual(values = cols, drop = FALSE) +
    scale_x_continuous(
      breaks = plot.dat$x[seq(1, nrow(plot.dat), by = 20)],
      labels = plot.dat$item_id[seq(1, nrow(plot.dat), by = 20)],
      expand = expansion(mult = c(0.005, 0.005))) +
    scale_y_continuous(
        limits = c(-0.94, 0.94),
        breaks = seq(-1, 1, by = 0.2)) +
    labs(
      x = "Item",
      y = expression(Delta*"Production probability (Left - Right)"),
      title = paste0("Total vocabulary size (prop) = ", target_pTot),
      colour = NULL) +
    coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
    theme_bw(base_size = 13) +
    theme(
      panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.minor.x = element_blank(),
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 1, size = 7),
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
      legend.position = "top",
      plot.margin = margin(t = 10, r = 10, b = 10, l = 10))
  
  ggsave(here("Figures", "MA_LR_by_VoA", paste0("MA_01_Diff_LR_pTot_", target_pTot, ".png")), width = 18, height = 6, dpi = 300)
}
```

### By category

```{r}
diff.cat.summary <- diff.summary %>%
  mutate(
    pTot = round(as.numeric(pTot), 1),
    category1 = factor(category1, levels = cat1_levels),
    category2 = factor(category2, levels = c("nouns", "verbs", "adjectives", "function_words", "other"))) %>%
  group_by(pTot, category1, category2) %>%
  summarize(
    mean_diff_m = mean(mean_diff, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_diff_sd = sd(mean_diff, na.rm = TRUE),
    n = sum(!is.na(mean_diff)),
    mean_diff_se = mean_diff_sd / sqrt(n),
    .groups = "drop")

cat2_summary <- diff.summary %>%
  mutate(
    pTot = round(as.numeric(pTot), 1),
    category2 = factor(category2, levels = c("nouns", "verbs", "adjectives", "function_words", "other"))) %>%
  group_by(pTot, category2) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_diff_m = mean(mean_diff, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_diff_sd = sd(mean_diff, na.rm = TRUE),
    n = sum(!is.na(mean_diff)),
    mean_diff_se = mean_diff_sd / sqrt(n),
    .groups = "drop")

label_dat <- diff.cat.summary %>%
  group_by(category1, category2) %>%
  filter(pTot == max(pTot)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  arrange(mean_diff_m) %>%
  mutate(
    y_lab = case_when(
        category1 == "toys" ~ mean_diff_m + 0.03,
        category1 == "outside" ~ mean_diff_m + 0.03,
        TRUE ~ mean_diff_m))

ggplot(diff.cat.summary, aes(x = pTot, y = mean_diff_m, group = category1, color = category2)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, colour = "grey20", linewidth = 1.0) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.7, alpha = 0.15) +
  geom_ribbon(
    data = cat2_summary,
    aes(
      x = pTot,
      ymin = mean_diff_m - mean_diff_se,
      ymax = mean_diff_m + mean_diff_se,
      fill = category2,
      group = category2),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    alpha = 0.10,
    colour = NA,
    show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_line(
    data = cat2_summary,
    aes(x = pTot, y = mean_diff_m, group = category2, colour = category2),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    linewidth = 2.4,
    alpha = 0.98,
    show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_point(
    data = cat2_summary,
    aes(x = pTot, y = mean_diff_m, colour = category2),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    size = 3.5,
    show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_text_repel(
    data = label_dat,
    aes(y = y_lab, label = category1),
    direction = "y",
    hjust = 0,
    nudge_x = 0.035,
    size = 3.1,
    segment.color = "grey75",
    segment.alpha = 0.7,
    segment.size = 0.3,
    box.padding = 0.18,
    point.padding = 0.12,
    min.segment.length = 0,
    max.overlaps = Inf,
    seed = 123,
    show.legend = FALSE) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = cols, drop = FALSE) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = cols, drop = FALSE) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = seq(0.1, 0.9, by = 0.1),
    limits = c(0.1, 0.98)) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0.1, 1.02), ylim = c(-0.7, 0.6), clip = "off") +
  labs(
    x = "Total vocabulary size (prop)",
    y = expression(Delta*"Production probability (Left - Right)"),
    colour = "Lexical category") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "right",
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()) +
  guides(
    color = guide_legend(
      override.aes = list(linewidth = 2.4, alpha = 1, size = 3.5)))

ggsave(here("Figures", "MA_02_Diff_LR_Cat.png"), width = 12, height = 6, dpi = 300)
```

### Noun-verb differences across samples

```{r}
item_key <- d.item %>% 
  transmute(item_id = item_id, category2) %>%
  filter(category2 %in% c("nouns", "verbs"))

calc_nv_index <- function(df, position_name) {
  df %>%
    mutate(
      sample_id = row_number(),
      pTot = round(as.numeric(pTot), 1)) %>%
    pivot_longer(
      cols = starts_with("item_"),
      names_to = "item_id",
      values_to = "prob") %>%
    inner_join(item_key, by = "item_id") %>%
    group_by(sample_id, pTot, category2) %>%
    summarise(
      cat_mean = mean(prob, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop") %>%
    tidyr::pivot_wider(
      names_from = category2,
      values_from = cat_mean) %>%
    mutate(
      nv_diff = nouns - verbs,
      nv_ratio = nouns / verbs,
      nv_logratio = log((nouns + 0.001) / (verbs + 0.001)),
      position = position_name)
}
```

```{r}
nv.indiv <- bind_rows(
  calc_nv_index(d.left, "left"),

  calc_nv_index(d.center, "center"))

nv.summary <- nv.indiv %>%
  group_by(position, pTot) %>%
  summarize(
    mean_nv = mean(nv_diff, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_nv = sd(nv_diff, na.rm = TRUE),
    # if interested in ratio:
    # mean_nv = mean(nv_logratio, na.rm = TRUE),
    # sd_nv = sd(nv_logratio, na.rm = TRUE),
    n = sum(!is.na(nv_diff)),
    se_nv = sd_nv / sqrt(n),
    .groups = "drop") %>% 
  mutate(position = factor(position, levels = c("left", "center", "right")))

cols_pos <- c(
  left = "#2C7BB6",
  center = "#7B6FD0",
  right = "#1A9850")

ggplot(nv.summary, aes(x = pTot, y = mean_nv, colour = position, group = position)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, colour = "grey25", linewidth = 0.9) +

    colour = NA,
    show.legend = FALSE) +
```

## Back-Front axis

### By item

```{r}
d.back.long <- d.back %>% pivot_longer(starts_with("item_"), names_to = "item_id", values_to = "prob")
d.front.long <- d.front %>% pivot_longer(starts_with("item_"), names_to = "item_id", values_to = "prob")

back.summary <- d.back.long %>% group_by(pTot, item_id) %>%
  summarize(mean_1 = mean(prob), var_1 = var(prob), .groups = "drop")
front.summary <- d.front.long %>% group_by(pTot, item_id) %>%
  summarize(mean_2 = mean(prob), var_2 = var(prob), .groups = "drop")

diff.summary <- front.summary %>% left_join(back.summary, by=c("pTot", "item_id")) %>%
  mutate(mean_diff = mean_1 - mean_2, 
         sd_diff   = sqrt(var_1 + var_2)) %>%
  left_join(d.item, by = c("item_id"))
```

```{r}
# Visualization, example 1

target_pTot <- 0.5

plot.dat <- diff.summary %>%
  filter(pTot == target_pTot) %>%
  mutate(
    category1 = factor(category1, levels = cat1_levels),
    category2 = factor(category2, levels = cat2_levels),
    item_num = parse_number(item_id)) %>%
  arrange(category1, item_num) %>%                    # if you want to arrange items by item_id
  # arrange(category1, is.na(VoA_raw), VoA_raw, item_num) %>%   # if you want to arrange items by VoA
  mutate(
    x = row_number(),
    ymin = mean_diff - sd_diff,
    ymax = mean_diff + sd_diff)

cat.pos <- plot.dat %>%
  group_by(category1) %>%
  summarise(
    xmin = min(x),
    xmax = max(x),
    xmid = (xmin + xmax) / 2,
    .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(
    cat_label = cat1_labels[as.character(category1)],
    band_id = row_number())

vline.dat <- cat.pos %>% slice(-n())

target_vline.dat <- plot.dat %>%
  filter(!is.na(VoA_raw)) %>%
  group_by(category1) %>%
  summarise(
    xintercept = {
      before <- x[VoA_raw <= target_pTot]
      after  <- x[VoA_raw >  target_pTot]
      if (length(before) > 0 && length(after) > 0) {
        max(before) + 0.5
      } else {
        NA_real_
      }
    },
    .groups = "drop") %>%
  filter(!is.na(xintercept))
    
ggplot(plot.dat, aes(x = x, y = mean_diff, color = category2)) +
  geom_rect(
    data = cat.pos,
    aes(
      xmin = xmin - 0.5,
      xmax = xmax + 0.5,
      ymin = -Inf,
      ymax = Inf,
      fill = factor(band_id %% 2)),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    alpha = 0.06,
    colour = NA,
    show.legend = FALSE) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("0" = "grey70", "1" = "white")) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, colour = "grey70", linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_linerange(
    aes(ymin = ymin, ymax = ymax),
    alpha = 0.22, linewidth = 0.35) +
  geom_segment(
    aes(xend = x, y = 0, yend = mean_diff),
    alpha = 0.25, linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_point(size = 1.1, alpha = 0.9) +
  geom_vline(
    data = vline.dat,
    aes(xintercept = xmax + 0.5),
    linetype = "dashed",
    colour = "grey75",
    linewidth = 0.4) +
  # geom_vline(                        # comment out this section if you arrange items by item_id
  #   data = target_vline.dat,
  #   aes(xintercept = xintercept),
  #   inherit.aes = FALSE,
  #   linetype = "solid",
  #   colour = "#D73027",
  #   linewidth = 0.5,
  #   alpha = 0.3) +
  geom_text(
    data = cat.pos,
    aes(x = xmid, y = 0.85, label = cat_label),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    vjust = 1,
    size = 2.6,
    lineheight = 0.9,
    colour = "grey10") +
  scale_color_manual(values = cols, drop = FALSE) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = plot.dat$x[seq(1, nrow(plot.dat), by = 20)],
    labels = plot.dat$item_id[seq(1, nrow(plot.dat), by = 20)],
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0.005, 0.005))) +
  scale_y_continuous(
      limits = c(-0.94, 0.94),
      breaks = seq(-1, 1, by = 0.2)) +
  labs(
    x = "Item",
    y = expression(Delta*"Production probability (Back - Front)"),
    title = paste0("Total vocabulary size (prop) = ", target_pTot),
    colour = NULL) +
  coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor.x = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 1, size = 7),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "top",
    plot.margin = margin(t = 10, r = 10, b = 10, l = 10))

ggsave(here("Figures", "MA_BF_by_itemID", paste0("MA_01_Diff_BF_pTot_", target_pTot, ".png")), width = 18, height = 6, dpi = 300)
```

```{r}
plot_diff_by_item_pTot <- function(target_pTot, diff_df) {
  
  plot.dat <- diff.summary %>%
    filter(pTot == target_pTot) %>%
    mutate(
      category1 = factor(category1, levels = cat1_levels),
      category2 = factor(category2, levels = cat2_levels),
      item_num = parse_number(item_id)) %>%
    # arrange(category1, item_num) %>%                    # if you want to arrange items by item_id
    arrange(category1, is.na(VoA_raw), VoA_raw, item_num) %>%   # if you want to arrange items by VoA
    mutate(
      x = row_number(),
      ymin = mean_diff - sd_diff,
      ymax = mean_diff + sd_diff)
  
  cat.pos <- plot.dat %>%
    group_by(category1) %>%
    summarise(
      xmin = min(x),
      xmax = max(x),
      xmid = (xmin + xmax) / 2,
      .groups = "drop") %>%
    mutate(
      cat_label = cat1_labels[as.character(category1)],
      band_id = row_number())
  
  vline.dat <- cat.pos %>% slice(-n())
  
  target_vline.dat <- plot.dat %>%
    filter(!is.na(VoA)) %>%
    group_by(category1) %>%
    summarise(
      xintercept = {
        before <- x[VoA_raw <= target_pTot]
        after  <- x[VoA_raw >  target_pTot]
        if (length(before) > 0 && length(after) > 0) {
          max(before) + 0.5
        } else {
          NA_real_
        }
      },
      .groups = "drop") %>%
    filter(!is.na(xintercept))
      
  ggplot(plot.dat, aes(x = x, y = mean_diff, color = category2)) +
    geom_rect(
      data = cat.pos,
      aes(
        xmin = xmin - 0.5,
        xmax = xmax + 0.5,
        ymin = -Inf,
        ymax = Inf,
        fill = factor(band_id %% 2)),
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      alpha = 0.06,
      colour = NA,
      show.legend = FALSE) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("0" = "grey70", "1" = "white")) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, colour = "grey70", linewidth = 0.4) +
    geom_linerange(
      aes(ymin = ymin, ymax = ymax),
      alpha = 0.22, linewidth = 0.35) +
    geom_segment(
      aes(xend = x, y = 0, yend = mean_diff),
      alpha = 0.25, linewidth = 0.3) +
    geom_point(size = 1.1, alpha = 0.9) +
    geom_vline(
      data = vline.dat,
      aes(xintercept = xmax + 0.5),
      linetype = "dashed",
      colour = "grey75",
      linewidth = 0.4) +
    geom_vline(                        # comment out this section if you arrange items by item_id
      data = target_vline.dat,
      aes(xintercept = xintercept),
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      linetype = "solid",
      colour = "#D73027",
      linewidth = 0.5,
      alpha = 0.3) +
    geom_text(
      data = cat.pos,
      aes(x = xmid, y = 0.85, label = cat_label),
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      vjust = 1,
      size = 2.6,
      lineheight = 0.9,
      colour = "grey10") +
    scale_color_manual(values = cols, drop = FALSE) +
    scale_x_continuous(
      breaks = plot.dat$x[seq(1, nrow(plot.dat), by = 20)],
      labels = plot.dat$item_id[seq(1, nrow(plot.dat), by = 20)],
      expand = expansion(mult = c(0.005, 0.005))) +
    scale_y_continuous(
        limits = c(-0.94, 0.94),
        breaks = seq(-1, 1, by = 0.2)) +
    labs(
      x = "Item",
      y = expression(Delta*"Production probability (Back - Front)"),
      title = paste0("Total vocabulary size (prop) = ", target_pTot),
      colour = NULL) +
    coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
    theme_bw(base_size = 13) +
    theme(
      panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.minor.x = element_blank(),
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 1, size = 7),
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
      legend.position = "top",
      plot.margin = margin(t = 10, r = 10, b = 10, l = 10))
  
  # ggsave(here("Figures", "MA_BF_by_itemID", paste0("MA_01_Diff_BF_pTot_", target_pTot, ".png")), width = 18, height = 6, dpi = 300)
  ggsave(here("Figures", "MA_BF_by_VoA", paste0("MA_01_Diff_BF_pTot_", target_pTot, ".png")), width = 18, height = 6, dpi = 300)
}
```

### By category

```{r}
bin_width <- 0.1

base.dat <- diff.summary %>%
  mutate(
    pTot = round(as.numeric(pTot), 1),
    rel_VoA = VoA_raw - pTot,
    category2 = factor(category2, levels = c("nouns", "verbs", "adjectives", "function_words", "other")),
    pTot_bin = case_when(
      pTot <= 0.3 ~ "0.1–0.3",
      pTot <= 0.6 ~ "0.4–0.6",
      TRUE ~ "0.7–0.9"),
    pTot_bin = factor(pTot_bin, levels = c("0.1–0.3", "0.4–0.6", "0.7–0.9")),
    rel_bin_mid = floor(rel_VoA / bin_width) * bin_width + bin_width / 2) %>%
  filter(!is.na(mean_diff), !is.na(pTot_bin), rel_bin_mid >= -0.85, rel_bin_mid <= 0.85)

bin.dat.all <- base.dat %>%
  group_by(category2, rel_bin_mid) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_diff_m = mean(mean_diff, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_diff_sd = sd(mean_diff, na.rm = TRUE),
    n = sum(!is.na(mean_diff)),
    mean_diff_se = mean_diff_sd / sqrt(n),
    .groups = "drop")

bin.dat.all2 <- base.dat %>%
  group_by(rel_bin_mid) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_diff_m = mean(mean_diff, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_diff_sd = sd(mean_diff, na.rm = TRUE),
    n = sum(!is.na(mean_diff)),
    mean_diff_se = mean_diff_sd / sqrt(n),
    .groups = "drop")

bin.dat.stage <- base.dat %>%
  group_by(category2, pTot_bin, rel_bin_mid) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_diff_m = mean(mean_diff, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop")

label.dat <- bin.dat.stage %>%
  filter(category2 == "other") %>%
  group_by(pTot_bin) %>%
  filter(rel_bin_mid == max(rel_bin_mid, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  arrange(mean_diff_m) %>%
  mutate(
    x_lab = 0.93,
    y_lab = seq(min(mean_diff_m), max(mean_diff_m), length.out = n()))

ggplot() +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, colour = "grey20", linewidth = 1.0) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, colour = "grey35", linewidth = 0.8, linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_ribbon(
    data = bin.dat.all2 %>% mutate(panel = "Overall mean"),
    aes(x = rel_bin_mid, ymin = mean_diff_m - mean_diff_se, ymax = mean_diff_m + mean_diff_se),
    fill = "grey45",
    alpha = 0.7,
    colour = NA) +
  geom_line(
    data = bin.dat.all2 %>% mutate(panel = "Overall mean"),
    aes(x = rel_bin_mid, y = mean_diff_m),
    colour = "grey30",
    linewidth = 2.4,
    alpha = 0.98) +
  geom_point(
    data = bin.dat.all2 %>% mutate(panel = "Overall mean"),
    aes(x = rel_bin_mid, y = mean_diff_m),
    colour = "grey30",
    size = 3.0) +
  geom_ribbon(
    data = bin.dat.all %>% mutate(panel = "By lexical category"),
    aes(x = rel_bin_mid, ymin = mean_diff_m - mean_diff_se, ymax = mean_diff_m + mean_diff_se, fill = category2),
    alpha = 0.10,
    colour = NA,
    show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_line(
    data = bin.dat.all %>% mutate(panel = "By lexical category"),
    aes(x = rel_bin_mid, y = mean_diff_m, colour = category2),
    linewidth = 2.4,
    alpha = 0.98,
    show.legend = TRUE) +
  geom_point(
    data = bin.dat.all %>% mutate(panel = "By lexical category"),
    aes(x = rel_bin_mid, y = mean_diff_m, colour = category2),
    size = 3.0,
    show.legend = FALSE) +
  facet_wrap(
    ~ factor(panel, levels = c("Overall mean", "By lexical category")),
    nrow = 1) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = cols, drop = FALSE) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = cols, drop = FALSE, guide = "none") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(-0.8, 0.8, by = 0.2), limits = c(-0.85, 0.85)) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(-0.85, 0.85), ylim = c(-0.4, 0.3), clip = "off") +
  labs(
    x = "More common <               VoA - reference vocabulary size              > More idiosyncratic",
    y = expression(Delta*"Production probability (Back - Front)"),
    colour = "Lexical category") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "right",
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold")) +
  guides(
    colour = guide_legend(override.aes = list(linewidth = 2.4, alpha = 1, size = 3.5)))

ggsave(here("Figures", "MA_04_Diff_BF_Cat.png"), width = 10, height = 5, dpi = 300)
```

### Profile diversity

```{r}
axis_cols <- c(
  Front  = "#D86F93",
  Center = "#7B6FD0",
  Back   = "#E8A93E")


# if you want to create "mean" profile and then calculate pairwise correlations (against the "mean profile")
calc_profile_cor_summary <- function(df, axis_label) {
  
  out <- data.frame()
  
  for (pt in seq(0.1, 0.9, by = 0.1)) {
    tmp <- df %>%
      mutate(pTot = round(as.numeric(pTot), 1)) %>%
      filter(pTot == round(pt, 1)) %>%
      select(starts_with("item_")) %>%
      as.matrix()
    
    if (nrow(tmp) == 0) {
      out <- bind_rows(
        out,
        tibble(
          pTot = pt,
          ID = NA_integer_,
          profile_cor = NA_real_,
          axis = axis_label))
      next
    }
    
    mean_profile <- colMeans(tmp, na.rm = TRUE)
    
    cor_each <- apply(tmp, 1, function(x) {
      cor(x, mean_profile, use = "pairwise.complete.obs")
    })
    
    out <- bind_rows(
      out,
      tibble(
        pTot = pt,
        ID = seq_along(cor_each),
        profile_cor = cor_each,
        axis = axis_label))
  }
  out
}

profile.cor.all <- bind_rows(
  calc_profile_cor_summary(d.front, "Front"),
  calc_profile_cor_summary(d.center, "Center"),
  calc_profile_cor_summary(d.back, "Back")) %>%
  mutate(axis = factor(axis, levels = c("Back", "Center", "Front")))

profile.cor.summary <- profile.cor.all %>%
  group_by(pTot, axis) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_cor = mean(profile_cor, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_cor = sd(profile_cor, na.rm = TRUE),
    n = sum(!is.na(profile_cor)),
    se_cor = sd_cor / sqrt(n),
    .groups = "drop")

ggplot(profile.cor.summary, aes(x = pTot, y = mean_cor, colour = axis, group = axis)) +
  geom_ribbon(
    aes(ymin = mean_cor - se_cor, ymax = mean_cor + se_cor, fill = axis),
    alpha = 0.22,

    show.legend = FALSE) +

  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0.1, 0.9, by = 0.1)) +
  labs(
    x = "Total vocabulary size (prop)",
    y = "Similarity to typical vocabulary profile (correlation)",
    colour = "Position",
    fill = "Position") +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(.989, 1), breaks = seq(.990, 1, .002)) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "right",
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    legend.title = element_text(face = "bold"))

profile.cor.summary.phase <- profile.cor.all %>% 
  mutate(
    phase = case_when(
      pTot < 0.4 ~ "0.1–0.3",
      pTot < 0.7 ~ "0.4–0.6",

ggplot(profile.cor.summary.phase, aes(x = phase, y = mean_cor, colour = position, group = position)) +
```

# Cor: LR vs. BF

```{r}
make_mean_profile <- function(df, pos_label) {
  df %>%
    mutate(pTot = round(as.numeric(pTot), 1)) %>%
    pivot_longer(starts_with("item_"), names_to = "item_id", values_to = "prob") %>%
    group_by(pTot, item_id) %>%
    summarise(mean_prob = mean(prob, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
    mutate(position = pos_label)
}

profile.mean <- bind_rows(
  make_mean_profile(d.left,  "Left"),
  make_mean_profile(d.right, "Right"),
  make_mean_profile(d.back,  "Back"),
  make_mean_profile(d.front, "Front"))
```

```{r}
# LR contrast vs. BF contrast

contrast.cor <- profile.mean %>%
  select(pTot, item_id, position, mean_prob) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = position, values_from = mean_prob) %>%
  mutate(
    LR = Left - Right,
    BF = Back - Front) %>%
  group_by(pTot) %>%
  summarise(
    r_LR_BF = cor(LR, BF, use = "pairwise.complete.obs"),
    .groups = "drop")

ggplot(contrast.cor, aes(x = pTot, y = r_LR_BF)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, colour = "grey25", linewidth = 0.9) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.3, colour = "grey20") +
  geom_point(size = 2.8, colour = "grey20") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0.1, 0.9, by = 0.1)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(-1, 1), breaks = seq(-1, 1, by = 0.25)) +
  labs(
    x = "Total vocabulary size (prop)",
    y = "Correlation between LR and BF contrasts") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 13) +
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank())
```
